content.title: New 2027 Corvette Grand Sport
content.text: New 2027 Corvette Grand Sport | High-Performance Sports Car Corvette Grand Sport Corvette Grand Sport Get Updates Grand Sport Lineup Preproduction models shown throughout. Actual production models may vary. Available features shown throughout. Anticipated availability late 2026. Get Updates Performance. Defined two ways. Introducing Grand Sport and Grand Sport X The true driver’s Corvette returns. Classic Grand Sport formula. New engineering breakthroughs. Two expressions of performance. Grand Sport delivers rear-wheel drive precision for maximum driver connection. Grand Sport X applies the same performance DNA through advanced all-wheel drive, enhancing control across a wider range of conditions. Grand Sport Footage (2:02) “Grand Sport is crafted with endless personalization. Grounded in the balanced, agile, race-bred precision that defines its heritage, it reflects your style without compromising its iconic performance DNA.” Megan Dalley Marketing Manager – Performance Vehicles Design For those who love to drive. The interior is anchored by a driver-focused command centre while a bold, wide-body exterior visually honours its heritage. The Grand Sport and Grand Sport X usher in a new era of performance design. Bold customization Available heritage-inspired accents pay tribute to the sports car legacy of Grand Sport with exclusive badging, new exterior and interior colour options, an authentic centre stripe and fender hash marks. Exclusive Wheels An exclusive package for true Corvette enthusiasts. Adorn your Grand Sport or Grand Sport X with custom stitching, a Santorini Blue Dipped interior, embossed headrest logos and a waterfall badge interior plaque. Available only on the inaugural 2027 debut models. Next-Generation V8 Engine The naturally aspirated 6.7L LS6 V8 is the heart of Grand Sport and Grand Sport X, continuing Corvette’s legacy of pure, uncompromising performance. With 535 horsepower and 520 lb.-ft. of torque, it responds with precision and authority to every input. Also available on the upcoming 2027 Corvette Stingray. 6.7L displacement 100 mm stroke 13.0:1 compression ratio Highest ever for a Corvette V8 New continuously variable oil pump Optimal oil pressure in all conditions Grand Sport X with eAWD Grand Sport X adds an electrified all-wheel drive front axle for enhanced performance and control. Electric Drive Unit Upgrades the front axle, providing 721 (1) horsepower and sending 145 lb.-ft. of torque to the front wheels. Battery Designed for maximum responsiveness and performance, with a 1.9 kWh lithium-ion battery capacity. “There is no replacement for displacement! Our next-generation LS6 V8 engine combines large displacement, modern technology and proven Small Block V8 heritage to deliver a bold new chapter in performance.” Mike Kociba Assistant Chief Engineer Performance A performance icon for every driver. Paired with the immediate low-end torque of the next-generation LS6 engine, the Grand Sport and Grand Sport X deliver an amplified driving experience with enhanced handling and control. 8-speed dual clutch transmission Magnetic Selective Ride Control™ 4.0 Available quad centre exhaust audio (00:32) Quad centre exhaust The available quad centre exhaust turns every throttle input into a direct, signature roar. Wide-body aerodynamics With a sculpted wide-body chassis optimized for aerodynamics, an integrated rear spoiler, aggressive wide side air inlets, and forged aluminum wheels, stability is enhanced and driving confidence is improved. Performance Packages Packages exclusive to Grand Sport and not available on Grand Sport X. Z52 Sport Performance Package Increases stopping power and road-grip for added confidence through corners. Performance Brakes High-Performance Tires Carbon Fibre Aero Package Enhances aerodynamics for increased grip, better balance and more confidence on the track. High wing Dive planes Rockers and front splitter Z52 Track Performance Package Delivers track-proven stopping power, sharper response, more precise cornering and added stability at speed. It combines aggressive styling and incredible handling performance with the most powerful standard engine ever offered in a Corvette.” Josh Holder Corvette Chief Engineer Technology Command the road with an outstanding connection. Large display screens, curated drive modes and informative performance apps provide an uncompromising experience with the driver at the centre of it all. Wireless charging (3) Located in centre console Standard Google (4) compatibility (subscription[s] required for full functionality) Wireless phone projection Standard Performance Data and Video Recorder Critical track insights are integrated directly into the vehicle’s displays. Speed tips Automated coaching tips highlight necessary improvements to increase track performance. Data analysis A detailed graphical analysis displays each lap driven around the track. Side-by-side video analysis Video playback compares laps from different sessions and even different drivers. Drive Modes Clips 1:30 [CORVETTE MODEL HERE] shown. Drive Modes Choose from 6 drive modes to match where you are, how you’re driving and the conditions around you. Each mode adjusts throttle response, suspension, steering and overall handling to deliver the right experience for the moment. Corvette Grand Sport and Grand Sport X models Available in Coupe and Convertible 1LT Removable roof panel (Coupe only) (5) premium 10-speaker system Standard 8-way power GT1 seats with Mulan leather seating surfaces Wireless phone (6)(7) HD Rear Vision (7) and Rear Camera (7) 2LT 2LT includes everything on 1LT, plus: 14-speaker (5) Performance Series sound system Heated and ventilated seats with power lumbar/wing adjust Performance Data and Video Recorder HD Curb View (7) Rear Cross-Traffic (7) and Side Blind Zone (7) Heated steering wheel Head-Up (8) (Standard on Grand Sport X only) 3LT 3LT includes everything on 2LT, plus: 14 interior colour options Custom Leather-wrapped instrument panel and doors Sueded microfibre upper interior trim Standard GT2 seats with Napa leather seating surfaces 1/2 Get updates on the new 2027 Corvette Grand Sport and Grand Sport X Chevrolet performance legacy Over 70 years of passion, performance and innovation.
